title: /groups/invite accepts unverifiable invitations fail-open when inviter pubkey unknown
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_invite.py:56-58. pubkey None -> signature never checked, invitation accepted+recorded; same pattern groups_remove.py:59-61 where roster=None disables can_remove entirely. Source comment defers crypto to sibling bead BUT until that lands forged inviter='owner' role=admin documents unlock join_key today; test_invite_acceptance_records_usable_invitation currently enshrines acceptance with empty pubkeys. Interim mitigation required regardless of crypto bead scheduling.
close_reason: Fixed fail-closed: GroupsInviteResource refuses invitations whose inviter lacks a known pubkey unless inviter == local node_id (provisioning carve-out, mirrors groups_remove node_id pattern); signature verified with verify_invitation_signature when pubkey available. Enshrining test flipped to genuine 48-byte Schnorr sigs (schnorr48 sign over canonical preimage, in-test Identity keypair). Split oracle tests: valid-sig acceptance, foreign-key rejection, tampered-document rejection, unknown-inviter refusal (test_groups_invite.py).
